context: Tests the entry flow's resume logic (SKILL.md step 1): a done phase is authoritative and never re-run, and a phase in progress resumes at its first non-done step without re-asking questions already answered under customer. Guards against resumability silently breaking after an edit to entry-flow or Phase B ordering.

checklist.name: No repeat of the entry question
checklist.description: The agent does not ask again whether the customer wants a new look / rebrand, and does not treat intent as unresolved. It proceeds on the basis that intent is already backend-only.

checklist.name: No re-ask of fork org/repo
checklist.description: The agent does not ask the customer for their GitHub org/repo — it uses the values already present in customer.githubOrg/githubRepo (or silently relies on them) rather than prompting for them again.

checklist.name: No re-ask of Content Hub credentials
checklist.description: The agent does not ask the customer to provide the Content Hub client id/secret again or tell them to create cloudflare/.secrets again — content-hub-creds-collected is already done and the file already exists.

checklist.name: No re-ask of tier choice
checklist.description: The agent does not re-present the three run-tier options or ask which one the customer wants — scopeChoice is already local-no-login and tier-selected is done.

checklist.name: Resumes at the correct next step
checklist.description: The agent's action moves to the actual next pending step — applying the local-no-login auth-bypass edit (uncommenting the DISABLE_AUTHENTICATION block in cloudflare/src/auth.js) and/or boot verification — not an earlier or unrelated step.

checklist.name: Plain language
checklist.description: No internal step ids, phase names, or file-internal jargon shown to the customer (I1).
